ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

Margo Morales, Chair  Lani De Benedictis, Commissioner
Barbara A. Pollack, Vice Chair  J. P. Shotwell, Commissioner
Raul Añorve, Commissioner  Susan Wise, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  23-51525  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Ethics Commission meetings of
  Wednesday, November 8, and November 15, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  23-51527  Recommendation to discuss the recent appointment process to fill the
  Commission’s current vacancy; and, if appropriate, provide suggestions to staff
  about future appointment processes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  23-51528  Recommendation to receive and file an update and discuss the Commission’s
  strategic planning efforts.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  23-51529  Recommendation to discuss succession planning of officers of the Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  23-51530  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ethics Officer.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 3
   ETHICS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 3:00 PM

6.  23-51531  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on the Lobbyist Ordinance.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  23-51532  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Ad Hoc Committee
  on Updated Policies.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  23-51534  Recommendation to reauthorize the Ad Hoc Committee on the Lobbyist Ordinance
  and the Ad Hoc Committee on Updated Policies to continue working on their
  respective recommendations to the Commission in 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  23-51533  Recommendation to discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects;
  and, if appropriate, take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Ethics Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
